serviceCard.title: LSP Service
serviceCard.description: The Hub reaches this LSP daemon over its NIP-98 dashboard. The backoffice below is served through the Hub; your browser never holds the admin key.

error.unreachable: The Hub could not reach the LSP daemon's dashboard.
error.keyMismatch: The LSP daemon rejected the admin key: the Hub's nsec/bunker pubkey is not this node's DASHBOARD_ADMIN_PUBKEY.

notConfigured.title: LSP service not configured
notConfigured.body: No LSP daemon is attached to this Hub.

unreachable.title: LSP service unavailable
unreachable.body: The Hub could not reach the LSP daemon, or its admin key was rejected.

generic.title: Could not load LSP data
generic.body: An unexpected error occurred talking to the LSP service.

overview.title: LSP Overview
overview.description: Monitoring home for your attached Liquidity Service Provider

orderStates.title: Recent order states
orderStates.description: Across the last orders lspd reports for this node.

fleet.title: Fleet ({{count}} nodes)
fleet.description: This daemon runs more than one LSP node. Per-node config and announcement are managed on the Config screen.

orders.title: Channels & Orders
orders.description: LSPS1 orders and the JIT channels they funded

filter.placeholder: Filter by order id, peer pubkey or alias

orderDetail.title: Order detail
orderDetail.readOnlyNote: The LSP dashboard API exposes order state read-only. Settlement and stuck-order recovery run automatically inside the LSP daemon, so there are no manual refund/reopen/recovery actions here.

payment.title: Payment
payment.noInvoice: No invoice recorded for this order.

clients.title: Clients & Peers
clients.description: Peers connected to this LSP node and their order activity

distributionChart.title: Order distribution
distributionChart.description: Orders by state across the sampled window.

config.title: Config
config.noNodes: No nodes configured on the LSP daemon.

fees.title: Fees
fees.description: Business fee parameters for this node. Secret fields (node key, tokens, LND credentials) are never sent to the browser and are preserved on save.

viewer.title: Node configuration
viewer.description: Read-only. Secrets are stripped by the daemon.

announce.title: NIP-LSP announcement
announce.description: Pause, resume or unlist this node's kind-10735 announcement, and clear a failed self-check.

alert.title: Managed by clients over the LSPS protocol
alert.description: Clients register and remove their own LSPS5 webhooks over the LSPS transport (bLIP-55). The LSP operator dashboard API does not expose a per-webhook registry, so there is nothing to list or edit here yet.

transports.title: Transports
transports.description: How notifications reach a client once it has registered a webhook.

push.title: push (HTTPS)
push.description: A signed POST to the client's https:// URL. Dial-time SSRF guard rejects private addresses unless loopback webhooks are explicitly enabled on the daemon.

nostr.title: nostr
nostr.description: An encrypted event (kind 31055) to the client's nostr+lsps5:// relay. Delivered through the daemon's relay pool.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Webhook limits are configured on the LSP daemon via environment (LSPD_LSPS5_MAX_WEBHOOKS, LSPD_LSPS5_ALLOW_LOOPBACK_WEBHOOKS) and are not editable from the Hub.
